description: BAL-04 (owner rule 2026-11-26: one normal enemy dies in 3-5 hits, two same-level enemies cost about half HP without gear, three need a level or gear advantage). (1) SOLO_ENEMY_CURVE: per-level HP/attack multipliers for size-1 non-dungeon encounters (solo quests, quest goal fights, road ambushes) at levels 1-14; group fights, dungeons, training dummies and level 15+ keep ENEMY_CURVE. (2) SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES: early solo encounters spawn at most two enemies. (3) EARLY_XP: rewards of levels 1-14 x1.25 so the campaign path keeps the hero at the quest level. Measured with scripts/sim_campaign.cjs.

edits.name: Solo enemy curve table
Apply the solo curve in spawnEnemy
edits.old: const chp = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'hp'), catk = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'atk');
edits.new:
const solo = ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter].size === 1 && ENCOUNTERS[st.encounter].type !== 'dungeon' && !st.test;
    const chp = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'hp', solo), catk = dummy ? 1 : enemyCurve(elvl, 'atk', solo);

edits.name: Expose the solo curve for balance reports
edits.new: ENEMY_CURVE, SOLO_ENEMY_CURVE, SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES, EARLY_XP, enemyCurve, heroStats,

edits.name: Early XP multiplier
Apply early XP multiplier in xpFor
edits.new: return Math.round(XPC.base * (1 + XPC.rew * (rewardLevel - 1)) * mult * grp * (rewardLevel < EARLY_XP.below ? EARLY_XP.mult : 1));

edits.name: At most two enemies in early solo encounters
